axes.yDefinition: log10 cosmic star formation rate density

selection.population: all star formation in the box
selection.warning: SFR density of the 100 Mpc/h SIMBA run, read from the vector paths of Dave et al. 2019 (about 1969 vertices of the plotted line). The x axis is cosmic time; each time is converted to redshift with the exact flat LCDM age relation (H0=68, Om=0.3, no radiation), validated against the figure's own redshift axis at z=0, 1, 2, 4 and 6 within 0.2 Gyr. The Madau & Dickinson points and fit overlaid in the figure are not extracted. IMF and the density frame (comoving) are not stated in the figure.

provenance.citation: Dave et al. 2019, MNRAS 486, 2827 (arXiv:1901.10203), star formation rate density versus cosmic time
provenance.figure: Star formation rate density evolution versus age of the Universe
provenance.extractionMethod: vector path vertices from the figure PDF (PyMuPDF get_drawings), transformed through axes calibrated on labelled tick marks
provenance.axisCalibrationPixels: x: cosmic time labels snapped to ticks; y: positive tick words negated (minus glyphs are separate) and paired with ticks

records.notes: Vector-path extraction; exact to PDF coordinate precision, so uncertainty is the plotted line, not marker tracing.
